notes: Garrard is printed 'GARRARD AV. (JEPTHA)'. West 8th is on the viaduct across the top; only its south half is on this sheet. The double-dashed line drawn at y~290 is NOT the centreline here: the south block face is at y~387-392 and sheet 33 shows the street 110 ft (375 px) face to face, so the true centreline is at y~200, right at the top paper edge; the two 8th Street points are computed that way and may be dropped if edge points are not wanted. Horne is printed bare 'HORNE'; only its west face (x~3720-3732) is drawn, centre taken from the width labels (50 ft printed north of 7th, 60 ft south of 7th) and the 6in water pipe at x~3815. Horne south of 7th is marked '(NOT OPENED)'. The unnamed 30 ft street south of Budd (alley entry) runs from the railroad line to Horne; it is not named here or on the key map and is built over on sheet 35. West 6th (60') crosses the rail yard at the bottom with no intersections; a third bend (to due east, north face kink at x~2853 y~4498, centreline ~y4600) falls just below the paper edge and is not recorded. Horne/West 7th and Horne/Budd are T: on sheet 35 the Banning lumber yard occupies both street beds east of Horne (Budd resumes east of the Cincinnati Southern trestle at a different alignment).
